mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (demand) over 1 month predicts higher corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window, or 5-day returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falls below 4.0% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months amplifies accommodative monetary policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both proxies move in specified directions over 3 months
failure_condition: The combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise does not produce statistically significant positive 20-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a drop in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% signals Fed readiness to ease, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL drops below 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months amplifies business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies move in specified directions over 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO rise and FEDFUNDS decline does not produce statistically significant positive 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeds 105.0, signaling robust production growth, triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Post-shock recovery regime: UNRATE falls below 5.0% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in post-shock recovery
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery, 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).
